**Definition** (`LukPropForm.Provable`). $\Sigma\vdash\varphi$ is generated by three rules: every axiom is provable; every member of $\Sigma$ is provable; and if $\varphi$ and $\psi\dot-\varphi$ are provable then so is $\psi$ (modus ponens). This inductive definition is equivalent to the paper's finite derivations: a formula is provable exactly when it is the last line of a finite sequence each of whose lines is an axiom, a hypothesis, or follows from two earlier lines by modus ponens.

**Definition** (`Consistent`). $\Sigma$ is consistent if there is a formula $\varphi$ with $\Sigma\nvdash\varphi$.
